label: Team roles
intent: A role is assigned and its badge is put on. Light: the role title clears, the badge is tugged out on its clip and swings back, and the role title writes itself in under the avatar as the swing settles. Strong: a small wind-up, a wider tug, two decaying swings, and the role title writes in as the badge comes to rest.

badge.//: the badge and its straps hang from the clip

motion.//: The badge is long (21.5 below its clip), so the tug is capped at 18 degrees: its swung Bold corner stays 1.4 inside the side edges.
